_README: Copy this file to unit-economics.json and fill in YOUR cost structure. These rates are the most important inputs — get them wrong and the CM number lies.
_default_cogs_pct_of_subtotal_NOTE: Cost of goods as a fraction of subtotal_price (after discounts, before shipping). 0.33 means $33 COGS on a $100 subtotal. Get this from your supplier costs.
_shipping_cost_avg_NOTE: YOUR cost to ship one order (USPS / UPS / fulfillment center fee). Not what you charge the customer.
_processing_pct_NOTE: Payment processor fee as fraction of total_price. Shopify Payments + Shop Pay typically 2.6-3.9%; Stripe + apps add ~1%. 0.041 = 4.1% — a defensible blended rate.
_returns_reserve_pct_NOTE: Returns + chargebacks as fraction of total_price. 0.02 = 2% — typical apparel/accessory range. Higher for fit-sensitive categories.
_usd_cad_rate_NOTE: USD per 1 CAD. Only needed if your spend currency differs from revenue currency. If both are USD, set to 1.0.
_currency_NOTE: Set to the currencies your Meta ad account and Shopify store use. If both are USD, set both to USD and usd_cad_rate to 1.0.
